CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Consent_Sent_to_DNO__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Target_Completion_Date__c)) ), Target_Completion_Date__c - Date_Consent_Sent_to_DNO__c, NULL )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows how many days ahead or behind the consent was sent compared to the target completion date. Positive values mean ahead of schedule, negative values mean behind.
CustomField.label: Days Ahead / Behind Target
